text.title: CR / BUG Tracking — Worked Examples
text.summary: One CR file (CR042), one BUG file (BUG019), the commit subjects for each, the shell one-liners that allocate the next number, and the business-rule entry BUG019 added to project-spec in the same PR.

section.title: CR file — one page, three sections

example.code:
# CR042: lower default rate-limit from 100/min to 60/min
linked-feature: F031
## Why Premium tier abuse logs show p95 traffic at 73/min from a single key.
## What changes - `apps/api/middleware/ratelimit.py` — default 60. - `tests/api/test_ratelimit.py` — adjust expectations. - `project-spec/non-functional.md` — update the rate-limit table.
example.note: Commit subject: `cr(CR042): drop default ratelimit to 60/min`. Lifecycle: `crs/todo/` → `crs/done/`.

example.code:
# BUG019: signup form accepts whitespace-only password
linked-feature: F012
## Symptom User submits " " (3 spaces) as password → account created, login impossible.
## Repro 1. Visit /signup 2. Email: test@x.com, Password: " " 3. Submit → 201 Created 4. Try login with same creds → 401.
## Root cause `UserSerializer.validate_password` trims whitespace AFTER length check; the length check ran on the un-trimmed string.
## Fix Trim first, then length-check. Add `MIN_LEN_AFTER_TRIM = 8`.
## Regression test `tests/api/test_signup.py::test_password_whitespace_rejected`.
example.note: Commit subject: `fix(BUG019): reject whitespace-only passwords`. Lifecycle: `bugs/todo/` → `bugs/in-progress/` → `bugs/done/`.

section.title: Allocating the next number
section.p: The next CR or BUG ID is one higher than the maximum currently on disk in either `todo/` or `done/` (and `in-progress/` for BUGs).

example.code: # Next CR ls crs/{todo,done}/ 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'CR[0-9]+' | sort -V | tail -1 # Next BUG ls bugs/{todo,in-progress,done}/ 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'BUG[0-9]+' | sort -V | tail -1
example.note: Two separate global counters per repo; the counter is never reset.

section.title: Revealing BUG — spec update in the same PR

example.note: BUG019 (signup accepts whitespace-only password) → same PR adds `BR-051: passwords are length-validated AFTER whitespace trim, minimum 8 chars` to project-spec/business-rules.md.

list.item: Repro and root-cause are what distinguish a BUG from a CR; the regression-test section is what keeps the defect from returning.
The `linked-feature: F0NN` header is optional, but it is what answers "what shipped in F0NN — and what came back to bite us afterwards?"
